meta.name: Chaar Yaar
meta.description:
A story of four middle-class boys, their dreams, setbacks and friendship being their armour. A fateful decision leads them to take a step that changes the course of their lives trapping them between gangsters and cops. What once held them together slowly tears their bond. With their armour shattered, their enemies close in and fate serves up a bill for their crimes.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 23 Oct 2026 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Pink Window Productions, BBC Studios India · Network: Prime Video

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: A friend in need…
videos.overview: The gang is back together for a cause - their friend needs them. Believing it's their only way out, they hatch a plan. Little do they know, there is no turning back

videos.title: Revenge Mode!
videos.overview: Babban is furious with the boys over what they've done. Meanwhile, both the Nagre Gang and the Crime branch are on Abu Quasim's trail but Quasim is already plotting his next move. Bhalerao is determined to catch the new car-theft gang.

videos.title: Research. Strategy. Execution.
videos.overview: Abu Quasim strikes again and with this message, he sends a clear warning. His rise is inevitable. Senior P.I. Wankhede spearheads Abu Quasim's investigation and Bhalerao is confined to a deskjob. Boys embrace the tempting offer by Imti, but they are aware - every opportunity comes with a price.

videos.title: These Boys Are Trouble.
videos.overview: Frustrated by their meagre earnings, the Yaars decide to start off their own. With Nalli's help they put together a plan, set everything in motion, and launch their own business. Babu manipulates Muthu to go against Imtiyaz.

videos.title: Saved Our Lives, but Lost a Fortune!
videos.overview: The scene descends into chaos and confusion as the Crime Branch struggle to make sense of the situation while Nagre's gang is scattered. Amid the disorder, the Chaar yaars seize the opportunity, using the confusion to their advantage and make their move.

videos.title: Who is the king of Mumbai?
videos.overview: With no competition left, the Yaars flourish in their business. Babu is about to dethrone Nagre to become the next crimelord.Little do Babu and the yaars know, that fate has other plans for them. Amidst the chaos, Bhalerao becomes more determined than ever to catch the car thieves.

videos.title: Twist of Fate!
videos.overview: Babu's happiness is short-lived as he discovers that the drugs have been stolen. Jay comes up with an ultimate plan but fortune abandons him. Bhalerao uncovers a crucial clue. Tensions begin to drive the Yaars apart.

videos.title: Bang! Bang! Climax!
videos.overview: The Loved ones of the Chaar Yaars are kidnapped by the gangsters. Will the yaars join forces and devise a plan to save them or will a price have to be paid? Will Bhalerao stand up to Wankhede? Will Babu get his 120 crore drugs back?
